mapper.select: SELECT `dev`.`thirdparty_id`, `dev`.`device_name` AS `name`, `dev`.`id`, `dev`.`device_code` FROM `center_biz_device` `dev` JOIN `center_biz_device_ref` `dev_ref` ON `dev_ref`.`ref_device_id` = `dev`.`id` JOIN `center_biz_tag_ref` `tag_ref` ON `tag_ref`.`device_id` = `dev`.`id` WHERE `dev_ref`.`device_id` = #{deviceInstanceId} AND `tag_ref`.`tag_id` = #{tagId}

SELECT `dev`.`thirdparty_id`, `dev`.`device_name` AS `name`, `dev`.`id`, `dev`.`device_code`, `dev_iot`.`iot_device_product_id` AS `iotDeviceProductId`, `dev_iot`.`iot_device_product_name` AS `iotDeviceProductName`, `dev_iot`.`iot_device_model_name` AS `iotDeviceModelName`, `dev_iot`.`iot_device_brand_name` AS `iotDeviceBrandName` FROM `center_biz_device` `dev` JOIN `center_biz_device_iot` `dev_iot` ON `dev_iot`.`id` = `dev`.`id` LEFT JOIN `center_biz_tag_ref` `ref` ON `ref`.`device_id` = `dev`.`id` WHERE `ref`.`tag_id` = #{tagId}
